title: Cookie Policy
intro: Information about the use of cookies on https://racinesversailles.com, operated by Racines Versailles.

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are used to remember your preferences, keep your session active or collect statistical information.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies used on this site
paragraphs: https://racinesversailles.com uses the following types of cookies:
bullets: Technical and functional cookies: necessary for the site to work (session, security, preferences). They do not require consent.

sections.heading: 3. Consent and settings
paragraphs: This site only uses technical cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work. Under the ePrivacy rules they are exempt from consent, so no cookie banner is required; this policy is published for transparency.
You can also manage cookies from your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
